question: Who along with Barry Marshall, was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2005 for discovering that stomach ulcer is an infectious disease caused by bacteria?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Robin Warren**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Robin Warren** along with Barry Marshall, was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2005.
 
• They discovered that **stomach ulcers are an infectious disease caused by the bacterium Helicobacter pylori**.
 
• This groundbreaking discovery revolutionized the understanding and treatment of peptic ulcer disease.
 
• Previously, it was believed that ulcers were primarily caused by stress, spicy foods, and lifestyle factors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Barry Marshall** famously ingested H. pylori to demonstrate its role in causing ulcers, leading to his development of effective treatments.
 
• Their work has led to the development of antibiotics to treat stomach ulcers, significantly improving patient outcomes.
 
• The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine is awarded annually for outstanding discoveries in the fields of life sciences and medicine.
 
• Helicobacter pylori is a type of bacteria that can cause infections in the stomach, often leading to chronic gastritis and ulcers.
